description: Synthetic regression inputs derived from reviewed commit diffs; expected values are explicit and independent of the interpreter. A cycle parameter written as {"unpinned": "<reason>"} is deliberately not pinned; the reason names its registry id (tests/support/defects.py). No case pins a registered defect. Cycle cases pass the CAM inputs tool_direction and spin that SolidCAM supplies with every drilling job. regression.count is the number of anchor occurrences the real commit changed (default 1).

cases.name: zigzag_compensation_changes_only_on_cam_event
cases.reason: Commit and source comment explicitly say lookahead pre-applied upcoming compensation to the current lead-out/zigzag move.

cases.name: fourth_axis_transform_angle_is_not_counted_twice
cases.reason: Commit explicitly replaces apos=angle-opposite_z_angle_const_y with apos=0; angle already contributes through nR1postransform.

cases.name: distinct_apos_and_bpos_map_to_separate_axes
cases.reason: Commit body explicitly maps apos to primary A and bpos to secondary rotary position.

cases.name: tool_change_selects_d1_before_preselection
cases.reason: Commit adds the D1 block immediately after the M06 block; the mechanical reason beyond initialization is not recorded.

cases.name: cycle81_positive_reference_plane
cases.reason: Diff moves RFP into the second argument and leaves DPR empty; old output omitted RFP and put it after DP.

cases.name: cycle82_positive_reference_and_dwell
cases.reason: Same repaired RFP/SDIS ordering; delay remains a separate argument after DPR.

cases.name: cycle83_positive_reference_and_upper_dwell
cases.reason: Commit reduces the upper dwell from 1 to 0.5; subsequent source comment identifies this as DTS, argument 10.

expected_parameters.unpinned: FDPR: PP-055, the first peck relative to RFP jumps by SDIS across drill_upper_z=0; a fix changes FDPR in one branch

cases.name: cycle83_nonpositive_reference_and_upper_dwell
cases.reason: The same dwell change for drill_upper_z<=0; one CYCLE83 tail serves every hole since the shared CYCLE8x head, and since the hole-top fix RFP=drill_upper_z-safety, SDIS=safety and DPR empty below Z0 too (before: RFP=-2, SDIS empty, DPR=0).

expected_parameters.unpinned: FDPR: PP-055, the first peck relative to RFP jumps by SDIS across drill_upper_z=0; a fix changes FDPR in one branch

cases.name: cycle86_positive_reference_and_spindle_mode
cases.reason: Diff repairs the first five arguments while retaining the final spindle-mode value 3 (SDIR 3 = M3 for the CW tool given here; the CCW case is PP-029).

cases.name: off_center_stock_uses_box_and_incremental_extents
cases.reason: Commit comment explicitly preserves real off-center stock extents rather than recentering with RECTANGLE.

cases.name: rotary_stock_preserves_off_center_box_on_a
cases.reason: 2026-10-27 user requirement supersedes the old RECTANGLE characterization: clamping to A must preserve the same off-center BOX extents.
